🌸 Understanding Perimenopause: The Transition Before Menopause 🌸

Many women experience changes in their bodies during their 40s, but may not realize they are entering perimenopause—the natural transition period before menopause. Perimenopause can begin several years before menopause and is caused by fluctuating hormone levels.

Common Symptoms of Perimenopause:

✔ Irregular periods
✔ Hot flashes and night sweats
✔ Mood swings and irritability
✔ Sleep disturbances
✔ Fatigue and low energy
✔ Weight gain
✔ Brain fog and difficulty concentrating
✔ Vaginal dryness
✔ Reduced libido

These symptoms can vary from woman to woman and may impact daily life, relationships, and overall well-being.

When Should You See a Gynecologist?

If you are experiencing persistent symptoms, heavy bleeding, missed periods, or changes affecting your quality of life, it is important to seek professional medical advice. Early guidance can help manage symptoms, maintain hormonal health, and improve long-term wellness.
